This trails layer includes only those trails that lie within CLOCA owned conservation areas, and that are sanctioned by CLOCA for use by the public. Trail information was collected by CLOCA staff using a handheld Trimble GPS unit, and QC'd using airphoto and hillshaded DEM interpretation. Data was typically collected between the months of May and November. The majority of the Trail data was collected between 2004 and 2008, with additional trail data added as sanctioned additions/alterations were made throughout the trail network.
